n5cfa4ef537.headline: Kenya: KRA Records Sh251.5bn Monthly Tax Collection in December
n5cfa4ef537.summary: The Kenya Revenue Authority collected a record Sh251.52 billion in taxes in December 2025, its highest monthly revenue in history.
n5cfa4ef537.why: Tax revenue levels affect government fiscal space, borrowing needs and sovereign debt investors' assessments of Kenya.

n1c3ea48e74.headline: Eurozone CPI finalized at 1.9% in December, regional gaps persist
n1c3ea48e74.summary: Eurostat confirmed headline eurozone CPI at 1.9% year on year in December, down from 2.1% in November. Core inflation slowed to 2.3% from 2.4%.
n1c3ea48e74.why: Eurozone inflation guides European Central Bank interest rate decisions, which affect euro yields and the currency.

nfa6bec3ea3.headline: Immuron Reports Continued Sales Growth
nfa6bec3ea3.summary: Immuron reported unaudited global first-half sales of A$4.2 million, up 5% on the prior comparative period.
nfa6bec3ea3.why: Immuron is an Australian-listed biotechnology company, and its sales growth indicates commercial traction for its products.

n94b9bd8de6.headline: Uzbekistan eyes automotive cooperation with Egypt’s Mansour Automotive Group
n94b9bd8de6.summary: Uzbekistan and Egypt's Mansour Automotive Group discussed expanding investment cooperation and industrial collaboration, with a particular focus on the automotive sector.
n94b9bd8de6.why: Mansour Automotive is an Egyptian vehicle distributor and manufacturer, and automotive investment can add to local industrial output and trade.

n3d09eacbf0.headline: Kyrgyzstan Increases Excise Taxes on Alcohol and Sweetened Beverages
n3d09eacbf0.summary: The Kyrgyz Cabinet of Ministers has approved higher excise tax rates on alcoholic beverages and sugar-containing drinks, including children's juices.
n3d09eacbf0.why: Excise taxes are government revenue measures that also change consumer prices for alcohol and soft drinks.

n91c5870ee2.headline: Fed Pressure, Rising Yields, and Geopolitics Keep Markets Range-Bound
n91c5870ee2.summary: Markets were mostly range-bound last week as focus turned to political pressure on U.S. rate policy, including reports of a Justice Department probe of Fed Chair Jerome Powell. Yields rose.
n91c5870ee2.why: The Federal Reserve sets U.S. interest rates, and its independence and policy path shape Treasury yields and global asset prices.

na7c5fc432f.headline: Bulgarian President Radev resigns amid speculation he will form his own party
na7c5fc432f.summary: Bulgarian President Rumen Radev said he will resign, fuelling speculation that he will form his own party for upcoming parliamentary elections. The announcement was made on January 19.
na7c5fc432f.why: Political instability ahead of elections can affect investor sentiment toward Bulgaria, an EU member with euro-area ambitions.

nbd715aac23.headline: IMF Raises India’s GDP Growth Forecast To 7.3 Per Cent For FY26 On Strong Economic Momentum
nbd715aac23.summary: The IMF raised its FY26 GDP growth projection for India to 7.3%, citing better-than-expected performance. Growth is seen moderating to 6.4% in FY27.
nbd715aac23.why: The IMF is the global lender whose growth forecasts shape investor views on emerging-market economies, and India is one of the world's fastest-growing large economies.

n018abaf0bc.headline: Crypto Fell Due to Risk Aversion, But Remained Within Consolidation
n018abaf0bc.summary: Crypto market capitalisation fell more than 3% on Monday in Asian trading after a sell-off in risky traditional assets following mutual US-EU tariff threats. Crypto markets traded through the weekend and ignored the news.
n018abaf0bc.why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency and often trades as a risk asset, so shifts in broader risk sentiment and trade tensions can move the whole crypto market.
n018abaf0bc.why_moved: A sell-off in risky traditional assets after US-EU mutual tariff threats led to risk aversion that weighed on crypto prices.

n0ee8ae32aa.headline: Everstone said to sell stake in India's Burger King operator Restaurant Brands Asia
n0ee8ae32aa.summary: Everstone Capital is reportedly offloading part of its stake in Restaurant Brands India, the Burger King operator. The family office of Ajanta Pharma is seen picking up some of the shares.
n0ee8ae32aa.why: Restaurant Brands Asia operates the Burger King franchise in India, and private equity stake sales in listed companies often change shareholder structure.

nb170929a93.headline: Blackstone-backed ASK Property Fund invests $23 mn in Navi Mumbai projects
nb170929a93.summary: ASK Property Fund, part of the Blackstone-backed ASK Asset and Wealth Management Group, invested Rs 210 crore ($23.1 million) in projects in Navi Mumbai.
nb170929a93.why: Blackstone is a large global private equity and real estate investor, and its Indian property investments reflect institutional capital flowing into Indian real estate.

n896ef57760.headline: Iran accuses President Trump of fueling protests amid rising death toll
n896ef57760.summary: Iran's supreme leader is blaming President Trump for deadly nationwide protests that have shaken the Islamic Republic, amid a rising death toll.
n896ef57760.why: US-Iran tensions affect oil supply risk, sanctions exposure and regional stability, all of which matter to global energy and investment markets.

n82593d39dc.headline: Act Three: Greenland
n82593d39dc.summary: Some European countries face US tariffs of 10% from February and up to 25% from June until the US acquires Greenland. Gold hit a record of $4,690 per ounce in Asian trade.
n82593d39dc.why: Tariffs on European trade partners can disrupt cross-border supply chains and weigh on growth, while gold typically attracts demand during periods of geopolitical stress.
n82593d39dc.why_moved: The report links the tariff threat on European countries to gold's record rally, with silver also at a record and copper higher. Investors are seeking defensive assets amid trade and geopolitical tensions.

n2bb5859ac2.headline: NZX50 slides 1% as a2 Milk knocked by China birth rate
n2bb5859ac2.summary: New Zealand's NZX 50 posted its steepest daily decline in two months, with a2 Milk leading the index lower. Investors feared weaker growth prospects for infant formula demand after China's birth rate fell sharply.
n2bb5859ac2.why: The NZX 50 is New Zealand's benchmark index, and a2 Milk is a listed infant formula company that depends heavily on Chinese consumer demand.

source.name: NBR | Business news & analysis | Independent, ad-free reporting

sources.name: NBR | Business news & analysis | Independent, ad-free reporting

n2bb5859ac2.why_moved: a2 Milk fell after a sharp drop in China's birth rate raised fears about growth prospects for its infant formula business, dragging the benchmark lower.

n9ae6aa351f.headline: RBI proposes linking BRICS' digital currencies
n9ae6aa351f.summary: India's central bank has proposed linking the official digital currencies of BRICS countries. The aim is to facilitate cross-border trade and tourism payments.
n9ae6aa351f.why: The Reserve Bank of India is the country's central bank, and BRICS is a bloc of major emerging economies seeking alternatives for cross-border settlement.

n1ed027fe82.headline: IMF warns of AI bubble risk to global growth outlook
n1ed027fe82.summary: The International Monetary Fund flagged the risk of an AI bubble to the global growth outlook. It also projects drawn-out, above-target inflation in Australia.
n1ed027fe82.why: The IMF is the global lender that publishes the World Economic Outlook, which shapes expectations for growth, inflation and financial stability worldwide.

n5d493bf778.headline: IJM confirms MACC, IRB presence at office
n5d493bf778.summary: IJM Corp Bhd said officers from the Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission and the Inland Revenue Board were at its office as part of their process. The company confirmed the presence on the day.
n5d493bf778.why: IJM Corp is a Malaysian construction and infrastructure group, and regulatory inquiries by national agencies can affect its governance and investor confidence.

n2dcd1f3511.headline: Everstone to sell stake in Burger King operator Restaurant Brands Asia
n2dcd1f3511.summary: Private equity firm Everstone will sell its entire 11.26% stake in Restaurant Brands Asia, the Burger King franchisee in India and Indonesia. The sale is part of a broader transaction.
n2dcd1f3511.why: Restaurant Brands Asia operates Burger King restaurants in India and Indonesia, and large shareholder exits can affect a company's share register and investor base.

nba0b6215ea.headline: Samos Energy Buys Suksan Salamander FSO from Altera Infrastructure
nba0b6215ea.summary: Energy assets investment firm Samos Energy has signed an agreement to acquire the Suksan Salamander floating storage and offloading unit from Altera Infrastructure.
nba0b6215ea.why: Floating storage and offloading units handle oil and gas at sea, and asset sales in this niche reflect capital flows in offshore energy infrastructure.

n660c9395e2.headline: Swiss Franc Rallies as Greenland Escalations Push Gold to Record
n660c9395e2.summary: Risk aversion spread across Asia and Europe after a transatlantic diplomatic and trade shock hit asset prices. Gold and silver hit fresh record highs as equities came under heavy pressure.
n660c9395e2.why: The Swiss franc and gold are traditional safe havens that tend to attract demand during geopolitical stress. Equities typically fall when investors reduce risk.

impacts.name: Swiss franc
impacts.why: The franc rallied as a traditional safe haven during the risk-off move.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n660c9395e2.why_moved: A transatlantic diplomatic and trade shock triggered risk aversion, sending investors into safe havens such as gold and the Swiss franc while equities came under pressure.

n37d56fc8a7.headline: Carney says Chinese EV deal an ‘opportunity’ for Ontario, auto sector
n37d56fc8a7.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney said the electric vehicle deal with China is an opportunity for Ontario and autoworkers. The statement addresses the Canadian auto sector.
n37d56fc8a7.why: Ontario is Canada's main auto manufacturing hub, so EV investment and trade arrangements there affect jobs, plants and supply chains.

n7cefcac93c.headline: China's economy grows 5% in 2025, despite Trump's tariffs
n7cefcac93c.summary: China's economy grew 5% in 2025 despite Trump's tariffs. Leaders had been trying to spur faster growth after a property market slump and pandemic disruptions.
n7cefcac93c.why: China's growth rate is a central gauge of global demand, commodity consumption and emerging-market risk.

nb12676f8dd.headline: Selangor has highest bankruptcy rate, teachers form significant proportion
nb12676f8dd.summary: Data from Malaysia's Insolvency Department show Selangor has the highest bankruptcy incidence in the country, with civil servants, particularly teachers, forming a significant share of cases.
nb12676f8dd.why: Household bankruptcy levels reflect consumer debt stress, which affects credit demand and banks' loan books.

n28a460d009.headline: Macro Morning
n28a460d009.summary: With Wall Street closed, risk markets sold off overnight as threats from the Trump administration toward Europe and counter-threats to the 2025 trade deal raised concerns of a wider trade war. European shares slumped.
n28a460d009.why: The EU is a major trading partner of the United States, so tariff or trade-deal disputes affect European exporters and equity indices.
n28a460d009.why_moved: Threats from the Trump administration toward Europe and counter-threats to the 2025 trade deal raised fears of a wider transatlantic trade war. European shares fell as a result.

naeecfed4fd.headline: Singapore’s property stocks set for best start in over a decade
naeecfed4fd.summary: Singapore's real estate sector has surged nearly 14% on expectations that upcoming earnings will reveal generous capital return plans. The rally has put the sector on track for its best start in more than ten years.
naeecfed4fd.why: Singapore real estate companies and REITs are important parts of the Singapore Exchange and are sensitive to interest rates and payout policy.
naeecfed4fd.why_moved: Property stocks rose nearly 14% on expectations of generous capital return plans in upcoming earnings. The article attributes the rally to those expectations.

nbb3d54b6bf.headline: Hyundai Card revives dormant 'Kimchi bond' market with $20m issuance
nbb3d54b6bf.summary: Hyundai Card has issued 29 billion won ($20 million) in domestic foreign currency-denominated bonds, known as Kimchi bonds. The company describes the issue as marking the first such issuance in a dormant market.
nbb3d54b6bf.why: Kimchi bonds are won-based foreign-currency bonds issued in South Korea, and they give Korean issuers access to foreign-currency funding.

nac03e8e24f.headline: Japan snap election puts BOJ–fiscal policy clash in focus, Goldman Sachs warned
nac03e8e24f.summary: Goldman Sachs said a stronger mandate for fiscal expansion could push markets to demand a higher term premium on JGBs, tightening financial conditions.
nac03e8e24f.why: The Bank of Japan sets monetary policy for Japan, and Japanese government bonds are a major global fixed-income market. Fiscal policy shapes bond yields and yen expectations.

n4f752a9e0d.headline: Debt service burden slides 23% to $11 billion
n4f752a9e0d.summary: The Philippines' external debt service burden fell nearly 23% to $11.02 billion from January to October, compared with $14.3 billion a year earlier, according to the central bank.
n4f752a9e0d.why: External debt service measures the cost of repaying foreign borrowings. Lower debt payments support the country's external finances and currency stability.

n798d87db88.headline: SEC streamlines amendment process for registered firms
n798d87db88.summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission is streamlining the amendment process for corporations' articles of incorporation and by-laws to speed up transactions.
n798d87db88.why: The SEC regulates corporate registration and securities markets in the Philippines. Faster corporate filings reduce administrative friction for companies.

n093d9e8b85.headline: TSMC Jumps on Strong Q4 as AI Chip Demand Surges
n093d9e8b85.summary: TSMC topped expectations with its fourth-quarter results and signaled another strong year ahead. The chipmaker cited surging demand for AI chips.
n093d9e8b85.why: TSMC is the world's largest contract chipmaker, producing advanced semiconductors for firms such as Nvidia and Apple, so its outlook is a read-through for the AI hardware cycle.
n093d9e8b85.why_moved: Results beat expectations and guidance pointed to another strong year, while the input cites surging AI chip demand as the driver.

n32e220fc9e.headline: ‘Governance gaps a drag on investor confidence’
n32e220fc9e.summary: Think tank GlobalSource Partners said governance weaknesses remain the primary factor weighing on investor confidence in the Philippines. The government has rolled out what it calls big, bold reforms.
n32e220fc9e.why: Investor confidence and governance standards shape foreign capital inflows and how markets price risk in emerging economies.

nde0ebe4c88.headline: More forceful reforms in line at SEC – Lim
nde0ebe4c88.summary: SEC chairperson Francis Lim assured investors of a steady business environment in the Philippines. He also promised more forceful enforcement to restore confidence.
nde0ebe4c88.why: The Securities and Exchange Commission regulates securities markets and listed companies, so its enforcement stance affects investor trust.

n818930863f.headline: ‘CARS incentives to be funded from DPWH budget savings’
n818930863f.summary: The government assured investors it will settle Comprehensive Automotive Resurgence Strategy incentives using savings from the Department of Public Works and Highways budget last year. The assurance was given to calm investor concerns.
n818930863f.why: The CARS program provides incentives to automakers operating in the Philippines, so funding certainty affects their investment plans.

ndb47a108c7.headline: ACEN activates 60-MW solar farm in Pangasinan
ndb47a108c7.summary: Ayala-led ACEN Corp. activated its first solar farm in Pangasinan, a 60-MW project. The activation strengthens the company's foothold in northern Luzon.
ndb47a108c7.why: ACEN is a Philippine renewable energy developer, and its project pipeline drives its growth in clean power generation.
